name: Radio Card
description: A radio group rendered as selectable cards with a title, description, and optional icon, for choices that need explanation.
usage:
<RadioCard
  label="Choose a plan"
  defaultValue="pro"
  options={[
    { value: 'starter', title: 'Starter', description: 'For side projects' },
    { value: 'pro', title: 'Pro', description: 'For growing teams' },
  ]}
/>

anatomy.description: A radiogroup named by the required label prop, with roving focus on the checked card.
A radio-role button per option; arrow keys move and check, skipping disabled cards.
The option's name and supporting explanation inside each card.
An optional decorative icon above the title.

dos: Use it for two to five choices that each need a sentence of explanation, like plans.
Write descriptions that contrast the options, not restate the titles.
Keep unavailable options visible but disabled.
donts: Don't use it for more than a handful of options; use Select or Combobox.
Don't use it when several selections are allowed; use CheckboxCard.

examples.title: Plan picker
examples.description: Vertical cards with descriptions and a disabled unavailable option.

examples.title: Horizontal with icons
examples.description: A horizontal layout with an icon above each card title.

guidance.useWhen: A single choice between a few options benefits from a description or icon, such as plans, billing periods, or delivery speeds.
guidance.avoidWhen: Options are short labels with no supporting text; RadioGroup or ToggleGroup is lighter. Several selections call for CheckboxCard.
guidance.behavior: Selecting a card checks it and moves focus like a native radio group; the checked card holds the group's only tab stop and arrows wrap around, skipping disabled cards. Supports controlled and uncontrolled value.
guidance.responsive: Vertical stacks fill their container; horizontal groups wrap cards onto multiple rows on narrow screens.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the checked card.
Moves focus and checks the next card, wrapping at the ends.
Checks the first or last enabled card.

notes: Cards expose radiogroup/radio semantics with aria-checked; the group is named by the required label prop.
Disabled cards set aria-disabled and are skipped by arrow-key navigation.
